THE HEART BEHIND THE OVEN

Hi, I’m Pasha.
Your neighborhood baker.

Baking has always been my favorite way to be creative. But after becoming a stay-at-home mom, it became something even more meaningful.

Pashabakess grew from that love: handmade gourmet cookies that feel warm, nostalgic, and a little special. Every batch is made with ingredients I love, attention to detail, and plenty of extra care.

Whether you’re treating yourself after a long day, sharing a box with friends, or celebrating a big moment, I hope my cookies bring a little comfort and happiness to your table.

With love, Pasha

A FEW SWEET DETAILS

Good to know
before you order.

Still have a question?
Let’s chat ↗

How far ahead should I order?

Please give Pasha one week’s notice. Every cookie is made to order, so a little planning helps make your box extra special.

Where do I pick up my cookies?

Pickup only in Tyngsboro, MA, normally between 10am and 7pm (Eastern time), based on your requested time and Pasha’s confirmation. The exact address will be sent on the day of pickup. Delivery and shipping are not offered.

Can I mix and match the flavors?

Yes! Choose any mix from the current menu. Boxes are available as 4 cookies for $14, 6 for $20, or 12 for $38. The minimum order is 4 cookies. For orders above 12, email Pasha to arrange whole dozens and confirm pricing.

How should I store my cookies?

They are best enjoyed within the first few days. However, if you don’t eat them immediately, please transfer them to a Ziploc bag or an airtight container as soon as possible to maintain their freshness.

Are the cookies suitable for food allergies?

Pashabakess is not allergen-free, nut-free, gluten-free, or dairy-free. Everything is prepared in the same kitchen using shared equipment, trays, utensils, and packaging areas. Because cross-contact can happen, I do not recommend ordering or sharing the cookies with anyone with food allergies.

How do ordering and payments work?

Order requests are welcome anytime with one week’s notice. Send your order request and Pasha will confirm availability and payment instructions. Venmo (@Palosha-Rashid) and Cash App ($Pashabakess) are the listed payment options. Please wait for confirmation before sending payment.

What is the cancellation and return policy?

Due to the nature of these treats, they cannot be returned or exchanged. If you need to cancel an order, give 2 days notice by emailing me. pashabakess@gmail.com
